name: Saltmere
opening: A ship drifted into Saltmere harbour last night with no one aboard. The old harbour master holds his lantern up to its torn sails. 'Captain's dinner is still warm on the table,' he mutters. Then, from inside the hold, something knocks three times.
picture: medium shot, (an old white-bearded harbour master in an oilskin coat holding up a lantern beside an empty ship with torn sails, the hero next to him:1.25), (foggy harbour dock at dusk:1.1), lantern glow
background: a misty harbour at night with wooden docks, lanterns and an empty ship with torn sails
beats: Get aboard the empty ship without being seen
Find out what is knocking in the hold
Learn what happened to the crew
style: sea mist, lantern light, deep blues
secret: The crew were turned into seagulls by a sea witch they tried to cheat.

cast.the harbour master: an old man with a white beard, a yellow oilskin coat and a brass lantern
